he: בְּצֵ֣את יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם בֵּ֥ית יַ֝עֲקֹ֗ב מֵעַ֥ם לֹעֵֽז׃
en: When Yisrael went out of Mitzrayim; the house of Yackov, from a people speaking a strange tongue.
Yehudah became His sanctuary; Yisrael, His dominions.

he: הַיָּ֣ם רָ֭אָה וַיָּנֹ֑ס הַ֝יַּרְדֵּ֗ן יִסֹּ֥ב לְאָחֽוֹר׃
en: The sea saw and fled; the Yarden turned back.
The mountains danced like rams; the hills like young sheep.

he: מַה־לְּךָ֣ הַ֭יָּם כִּ֣י תָנ֑וּס הַ֝יַּרְדֵּ֗ן תִּסֹּ֥ב לְאָחֽוֹר׃
en: What is with you, O sea, that you flee; O Yarden, that you turn back?
O mountains, that you dance like rams; O hills, like young sheep?

he: מִלִּפְנֵ֣י אָ֭דוֹן ח֣וּלִי אָ֑רֶץ מִ֝לִּפְנֵ֗י אֱל֣וֹהַּ יַעֲקֹֽב׃
en: Before the Master, writhe, O earth; before the Eloah of Yackov.
Who turns the rock into a pool of water, flint into a spring of water.
